test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In each of the following word-number pairs, the number represents the sum of the alphabetical positions of the letters in the word (A = 1, B = 2, ..., Z = 26 ). Four of the pairs follow this rule exactly. One does not. Identify the odd one out.

STONE: 73

GLASS: 58

BRICK: 44

WALL: 48

CEMENT: 60
solution:

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
